description: The line chart titled “Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset” illustrates the performance of different model variants of MS-FSLHate across three evaluation metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—on the HateXplain dataset. The x-axis, labeled “Model Variants,” is a categorical axis with five discrete conditions: “Full model (Ours),” “w/o Prompt,” “w/o Augmentation,” “w/o Attention,” and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation.” The y-axis, labeled “Metric (%)”, uses a linear scale ranging from 58 to 66, with major gridlines and tick labels at intervals of 2%. The purple line with circular markers represents Precision, starting at 65.45% for the full model, dipping to 61.06% without prompt, rising slightly to 62.22% without augmentation, increasing further to 64.06% without attention, and peaking at 65.44% for the variant without both prompt and augmentation. The blue line with circular markers indicates Recall, beginning at 65.78% for the full model, sharply declining to 59.64% without prompt, rebounding to 63.75% without augmentation, falling to 59.17% without attention, and ending at 56.82% without both prompt and augmentation. The brown line with circular markers denotes F1-score, starting at 65.16% for the full model, dropping to 60.16% without prompt, rising to 62.63% without augmentation, decreasing to 59.67% without attention, and concluding at 57.74% without both prompt and augmentation. A legend in the bottom-left corner maps each metric to its corresponding line color and marker style.
caption_used: Ablation study on the HateXplain dataset. The line chart illustrates variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants of MS-FSLHate. The x-axis represents the 'Model Variants', labeled as nominal categories: 'Full model (Ours)', 'w/o Prompt', 'w/o Augmentation', 'w/o Attention', and 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. The y-axis represents 'Metric (%)' with a linear scale, ranging from 58 to 66, marked at intervals of 2%. The purple line, representing 'Precision,' uses circles as markers and a solid line style. It starts at approximately 65.45% with the 'Full model (Ours)' and shows a consistent decline across the variants, reaching its lowest point at 57.74% for 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. The blue line signifies 'Recall,' featuring circles and a solid line. It begins at 65.78% for 'Ours', drops sharply to 59.64% with 'w/o Prompt,' and continues to decline steadily, reaching 56.82% at 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation.' The brown line illustrates the 'F1-score' using circles and a solid line, starting at 65.16%, decreasing to 60.16% for 'w/o Prompt', and showing a slight increase at 'w/o Augmentation' before dropping again to 57.74% with 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. There is a legend on the bottom left of the plot to infer the line color from their labels.
